summary.en: The private company's pipeline spans cardiometabolic disease, oncology, respiratory disease and eye health. Late-stage trials and externally sourced innovation remain substantial.
summary.zh: 这家私营公司的管线覆盖心血管代谢疾病、肿瘤、呼吸疾病及眼科，后期试验与外部创新合作均占有重要位置。

counts.note: Company-reported selected clinical projects on the Human Pharma pipeline, as of August 2026; projects/indications, not unique assets. Snapshot retained unchanged, not recomputed for November events.

ind.zh: 心力衰竭及降低心血管风险

ind.zh: 局灶节段性肾小球硬化；另开发蛋白尿性肾病

watch.en: First-half 2026 growth was driven by Jardiance and recent launches.
watch.zh: 2026年上半年增长主要由 Jardiance 及近期上市产品推动。

watch.en: The company says 50% of its pipeline is anchored in external collaborations.
watch.zh: 公司称其50%的管线依托外部合作。

watch.en: Verducatib has expanded into phase 3 COPD development alongside bronchiectasis.
watch.zh: Verducatib 在支气管扩张症之外，已拓展至慢性阻塞性肺疾病 III 期开发。

watch.en: Survodutide has reported phase 3 obesity and cardiovascular-safety results; liver-disease development is separate.
watch.zh: Survodutide 已公布肥胖症及心血管安全性 III 期结果，肝病开发属于独立项目。

sources: Company-authored IL-11 release on idw, January 19, 2026
gaps: Boehringer website opens returned empty/iframe-only pages. The curl fallback failed because host names could not be resolved. Indexed primary-company text supplied the pipeline and half-year information; partner company releases supplied accessible supporting detail. This limits full-page verification.
Counts are the company's August 2026 selected-project snapshot. They include zongertinib in registration and the then-active CKD project; they are not November-adjusted counts.
Already approved zongertinib and nerandomilast are excluded because a qualifying filed major new indication was not verified.
No specific forward milestone was sufficiently verified for any selected asset; next is null for all eight. Completed trial results are not relabelled as future catalysts.
Origin is null for vicadrostat/empagliflozin, obrixtamig and verducatib because precise provenance was not verified.

The September EASi-KIDNEY update URL was opened but rendered empty. Its detailed implications require direct primary-page rechecking; the selected vicadrostat entry is for heart failure/cardiovascular development rather than CKD.

Older-than-2026-06 supporting sources: January 2026 company-authored IL-11 release for acquired origin and April 2026 partner release for obrixtamig mechanism; August pipeline supplies current phase. January 2026 apecotrep release supports oral TRPC6 pharmacology; October 2026 company text supports internal discovery.
BI 765423 origin is supported by a company-authored release hosted on idw; the company website was not reachable. No news-reported catalyst date is used.
